_meta.name: pattern_breaker_thresholds
_meta.description: Hardcoded numeric thresholds for the Phase 1 deterministic detector. Every flag is produced by comparing a computed metric against one of these fixed values. No LLM, no learned weights, no randomness. Editing these values is the ONLY way to change detector sensitivity. Same input + same thresholds => same flags, always.

sentence_rhythm._desc: Detects a repetitive rhythm in sentence lengths (word counts). Low coefficient of variation OR strong lag-1 autocorrelation => mechanical rhythm.

burstiness._desc: Human writing is 'bursty' — it mixes very short and very long sentences unpredictably. Low burstiness (variance/mean of sentence lengths) is an AI tell. Also computes word-length burstiness.

sentence_structure._desc: Detects a repeated structural pattern in how sentences OPEN (first 2 tokens, lowercased, function-word aware). If the same opening template recurs too often => flag.

paragraph_pattern._desc: Detects uniform paragraph construction — near-equal paragraph lengths (sentence counts) and parallel opening structures across paragraphs.

ngram_formula._desc: Detects repeated multi-word 'formulas' (n-gram templates) reused across the text. Repeated 3-,4-,5-grams beyond expected frequency => formulaic.

transition_formula._desc: Detects overuse of the same formulaic transition/connective openers (Moreover, Furthermore, In conclusion, Additionally, etc.). Deterministic keyword list; counts occurrences.
